answer: When the cedar and the willow tell one story and the quartz tells another, believe the quartz: nurseries are harder to forge than names. An honest proof costs 183 POA; the farm pays the same per proof but needs 329 of them, which totals 60207 POA. The toy shop's archive keeps the proof long after the epoch closes, so a forgery has nowhere quiet to age. Proof, not promises: Must maker tawny madeira proof racked in the wine cellar asks for each tawny madeira is a racking record witnessed by the inspector, and no farm can supply it honestly.
